settings.headline:
A child who reads
can go anywhere.
settings.copy: WordBridge is a literacy foundation that puts books, tutors, and reading programs into the hands of children who need them most. We believe the ability to read is the single most powerful lever we can pull — for a child's confidence, their schooling, and their whole future.

settings.title: Measured in pages turned,
settings.intro: We track reading growth the way it matters — in grade levels gained, books finished, and children who discover they love to read.

settings.title: More than handing out
settings.intro: A book in a child's hand is a start. A tutor who shows up every week is how reading actually takes hold. WordBridge does both — and everything in between.

features.title: One-on-one tutoring
features.text: Every child in our core program gets a dedicated reading tutor who meets them weekly, at their pace, with books they actually want to read.

features.title: Books that go home
features.text: We send children home with books of their own to keep — because a home with books is the strongest predictor of a child who reads.

features.title: Family literacy
features.text: We teach parents and caregivers to read alongside their kids, turning bedtime into a reading ritual that lasts a lifetime.

features.title: School partnerships
features.text: We work inside under-resourced schools, training teachers and stocking classroom libraries so reading support reaches kids where they already are.

features.title: Bilingual programs
features.text: English and Spanish reading tracks, so no child is left behind because of the language they speak at home.

features.title: Summer reading camps
features.text: Six-week camps that stop the 'summer slide' and send kids back to school reading ahead of where they left off.

settings.title: From first page
settings.intro: Our model is simple and proven: meet the child where they are, give them a book they love, and never stop showing up.

steps.title: Assess
steps.text: We meet each child and find their reading level and their interests. No two readers are the same, and neither are our plans for them.

steps.title: Match
steps.text: We pair the child with a trained tutor and a stack of books chosen just for them — the ones that make them forget they're 'practicing'.

steps.title: Read together
steps.text: Tutor and child read together weekly, building fluency, confidence, and the habit of picking up a book on their own.

steps.title: Grow & celebrate
steps.text: We track progress, celebrate every milestone, and hand the child a library of their own as they grow into independent readers.

settings.note: We stay with a child for as long as it takes — often years. Reading is a skill that compounds, and so does our commitment.

settings.title: Your gift turns a page
settings.intro: A $25 gift puts a stack of books in a child's hands. A $50 gift funds a month of one-on-one tutoring. Every dollar moves a child closer to reading on their own.
settings.quote: I couldn't read a single word when I started. My tutor, Ms. Rivera, never gave up on me. Last year I read forty books on my own. Now I want to be a writer.
settings.cta_text: Give a child the gift of reading

settings.title: Reading changes
settings.intro: The children we serve, their parents, and the tutors who show up every week — on what learning to read really unlocks.

reviews.quote: My son used to hide his books and say he was 'dumb'. After a year with his WordBridge tutor, he reads to me at bedtime — and he's the one who picks the books now. I cried the first time he read me a whole page.
reviews.author: Marisol G.

reviews.quote: I volunteer as a tutor because I remember what it felt like to be the kid who couldn't keep up. Watching a child's face light up when they read their first full sentence on their own — there's nothing like it.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.quote: Our school serves families who can't always afford books or tutoring. WordBridge came in, stocked our library, and trained our teachers. Reading scores are up across every grade. They're a true partner.
reviews.author: Principal D. Whitfield
